INSERT INTO library
                (kind, id, status, liked, section, title, poster_path, year, vote,
                 added_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (kind, id) DO UPDATE SET
                status = excluded.status,
                updated_at = excluded.updated_at
            WHERE library.status IS NULL
